title: 第5章 鬼愁涧开天眼第6章 山如宝库青鹰博蟒
lines: “爷爷说过，财如流水，有出才有进……”
小陆沉碎碎念，安慰自己。
三两雪花银，能换多少水盆羊肉啊！
他舔了舔嘴巴，把肚中馋虫压下去。
只能委屈五脏庙，把犒劳自个儿的想法往后放了。
按着先前的计划，小陆沉精打细算，购置进山所需之物。
骤然失去一吊大钱，能置办的东西便不多。
小陆沉搓揉脸庞，努力恢复那副讨喜的模样。
穿过两条小街就看到热闹的坊市。
正是安宁县做买卖最好的地方。
小陆沉囊中羞涩，只能多看多对比，挑选价格最便宜的那家。
就这样东瞧瞧，西瞅瞅，也没买到几样合心意的东西。
一株大柳树下，方脸汉子开口招呼：“六子，你来买药进山？”
“是嘞。
王阿哥出摊啊？”
小陆沉刚应一句，便听那方脸汉子叹气道：“不是咱不帮张大娘的忙，实在没那能耐。”
“你过来准备买些什么？”
小陆沉目光落在用来解毒丸子上，开口询问道：“大叔，这‘百步消’咋卖？”
方脸汉子摆手道：“你这次进山不一样，鬼愁涧险要！
百步消根本不顶事！
唯有回春堂卖的好药，才有些效果。”
“我这儿有一贴祖传的‘狗皮膏药’，你看要不要。”
说着，方脸汉子从怀里摸出黑漆漆的膏药贴。
小陆沉心头微喜。
这狗皮膏药可是好东西！
制起来复杂，要用生川乌，生草乌、羌活、独活、冰片等数十味草药，经炸枯、去渣、收膏等工艺制成黑药膏，摊于狗皮之上。
医治风湿痹痛、跌打损伤往往有奇效。
倘若被蛇虫叮咬，贴上去也能化瘀解毒。
“王阿哥，这……”
小陆沉迟疑。
狗皮膏药是除回春堂的丹丸药散，采药人用得起的最好之物。
但价钱必然也便宜不到哪里去。
“一贴膏药，只收你五十文，去了山里，千万小心一些，莫要逞强。”
方脸汉子摇头道。
才五十文？
正常都能卖到八十文，一百文了！
小陆沉愣住，赶忙道谢：“多谢王阿哥！”
“六子，你也不容易。
我没啥本事，帮不上太多忙，这一趟凶险，早去早回！”
方脸汉子唏嘘不已，见着小陆沉相助张大娘，雨师巷的街坊邻居哪能没触动。
“好嘞！
王阿哥这份情，我记下了！”
被人这般良善对待，小陆沉心里一时间也有些暖意。
告别王阿哥，继续采买。
content_en:
"Grandpa said that wealth is like running water, only when there is an outflow, there will be an advance..."
Xiao Lu thought quietly to comfort himself.
How much mutton can be exchanged for three taels of snowflake silver?
He licked his mouth and suppressed the greed in his stomach.
I can only give in to the Five Zang Temple and postpone the idea of ​​rewarding myself.
According to the previous plan, Xiao Luchen planned carefully to purchase the things needed to enter the mountain.
If you suddenly lose a lot of money, you won't be able to buy many things.
Xiao Luchen rubbed his face, trying to regain his pleasant appearance.
Crossing two small streets, you will see the lively market.
It is the best place to do business in Anning County.
Xiao Luchen was cash-strapped, so he could only look and compare and choose the one with the cheapest price.
Just looking here and there, I didn't buy anything that I liked.
Under a big willow tree, a square-faced man said hello: "Liu Zi, are you here to buy medicine into the mountain?"
"Yes.
Brother Wang is out at the stall? "
Just as Xiao Lu Chen responded, he heard the square-faced man sigh: "It's not that we don't want to help Aunt Zhang, we really don't have the ability."
"What are you going to buy here?"
Xiao Luchen's eyes fell on the detoxifying pills and he asked, "Uncle, how do you sell this 'Bai Bu Xiao'?"
The square-faced man waved his hand and said: "This time you enter the mountain is different, Guichoujian is dangerous!
Baibuxiao doesn't work at all!
Only the good medicine sold by Huichuntang has some effect. "
"I have an ancestral 'dog skin plaster' here. Do you want it?"
As he spoke, the square-faced man took out a dark plaster from his arms.
Xiao Luchen was slightly happy.
This dog skin plaster is a good thing!
It is complicated to prepare. It requires dozens of herbs such as raw Sichuan Wu, raw Cao Wu, Qiang Huo, Duhuo, Borneol, etc., which are fried, dried, removed, and ointment collected to make a black ointment, which is spread on the dog's skin.
It often has miraculous effects in treating rheumatic arthralgia and bruises.
If you are bitten by a snake or insect, applying it can also remove blood stasis and detoxify.
"Brother Wang, this..."
Xiao Luchen hesitated.
Dog skin plaster is the best thing other than Huichun Tang’s pills and pills that medicinal people can afford.
But the price is certainly not much cheaper.
"I'll only charge you fifty cents for a patch of plaster. If you go to the mountains, be careful and don't show off."
The square-faced man shook his head.
Only fifty coins?
Normally it can be sold for eighty cents, or one hundred cents!
Xiao Luchen was stunned and quickly thanked: "Thank you, Brother Wang!"
"Liuzi, it's not easy for you either.
I don't have much ability, so I can't help much. This trip is dangerous, so leave early and come back early! "
The square-faced man was in tears. Seeing Xiao Lu Chen helping Aunt Zhang, how could the neighbors in Yushi Lane not be touched.
"Okay!
I have recorded this love for Brother Wang! "
Being treated so kindly, Xiao Lu Chen felt a little warm in his heart for a while.
Say goodbye to Brother Wang and continue shopping.
title_en: Chapter 5: Gui Chou Jian opens the eyes of the sky Chapter 6: The mountain is like a treasure house, the green eagle and the python
